zh-Hans: 我的斗志正旺，肾上腺素简直要喷出来了！
en: I'm fired up beyond belief! The adrenaline's pouring through me!

zh-Hans: 别小看我，敢放水，我就一口气超过去！
en: Don't underestimate me! Ease off, and I'll blow right past you!

zh-Hans: 高明，重心转移真是运用得炉火纯青！
en: Brilliant. His weight transfer is exceptionally good!

zh-Hans: 这对手够分量，能让我开着这辆 LEVIN 全力以赴！
en: Now this is a worthy opponent. I can give it everything in my LEVIN!

zh-Hans: 山路上最快的才是最帅的。你很有一套啊！
en: The fastest driver on the mountain is the coolest. You've got style!

zh-Hans: 专注一断，就会犯错。那时候才是决胜负！
en: Once his concentration breaks, he'll make a mistake. That's when I'll strike!

zh-Hans: 现在正是该撑住的时候！
en: This is where I have to dig deep!

zh-Hans: 如果输了，过去的自己就全被打碎了。赌上命，我也要赢！
en: If I lose, everything I've been will shatter. I'll risk my life to win!

zh-Hans: 拜托了，我的 4A-G 涡轮！别输给有钱人的烧钱改装，拿出骨气来！
en: Come on, my 4A-G turbo! Don't lose to some rich kid's megabuck tune! Show some guts!

zh-Hans: 好了，轻轻松松地跟着跑吧。
en: All right, I'll follow at my leisure.

zh-Hans: 跑得漂亮。
en: Nicely done.

zh-Hans: 小小年纪，跑法倒是老练得很！
en: For a kid, you've got a lot of finesse!

zh-Hans: 敢换成畏畏缩缩的跑法，我就从后面撞上去！
en: Start driving timidly, and I'll ram you from behind!

zh-Hans: 有一套，这才像话！
en: Well played! That's more like it!

zh-Hans: 开什么玩笑！
en: You've got to be kidding!

zh-Hans: 呜啊！
en: Whoa!

zh-Hans: 切！
en: Tch!

zh-Hans: 什么？！
en: What?!

zh-Hans: 可恶啊！
en: Damn it!

zh-Hans: 群马真是藏龙卧虎，刺激得我浑身发麻！世上居然有这么厉害的人！
en: Gunma is something else. What a rush! There really are incredible drivers out there!

zh-Hans: 那种事我绝对做不到，简直是神技，鸡皮疙瘩都起来了！
en: I could never do that. It's like a miracle. I've got goosebumps!

zh-Hans: 拖进持久战就正中下怀。比耐力，我可不会输给大少爷！
en: An endurance battle is just what I want. I won't lose to some rich kid on stamina!

zh-Hans: 我会一直撑下去，直到你先绷断、先犯错！
en: I'll hold out as long as it takes, until you crack and make a mistake!

zh-Hans: 踩油门的脚都在发抖，真是刺激得发麻！
en: My foot's shaking on the gas. What a rush!

zh-Hans: 这压力让人喘不过气，比以往任何对手都强！
en: This pressure is suffocating. More than any opponent I've ever faced!

zh-Hans: 只要我还在前面，就不会输！
en: As long as I'm in front, I can't lose!

zh-Hans: 我不会输！至少到了这一步，比的就是斗志！
en: I won't lose! At this point, it's a battle of determination!

zh-Hans: 谁先绷不住谁就输，来比比谁更能忍！
en: The first one to crack loses. Let's see who can hold out!

zh-Hans: 不过这家伙，看着不显，倒真够顽强！
en: Still, he's a lot tougher than he looks!

zh-Hans: 咬牙撑住，撑到最后，赢的就是我！
en: Hold on, keep holding on! In the end, I'll win!

zh-Hans: 我也就不客气了！
en: Then I won't hold back either!

zh-Hans: 别怪我啊！
en: No hard feelings!

zh-Hans: 真正好玩的现在才开始。来场痛快的吧！
en: This is where the real fun starts. Let's make it a good one!

zh-Hans: 好，感觉来了！
en: Yeah! Now we're talking!

zh-Hans: 街头较量，赢的是内心更强的那一个！
en: In a street battle, the stronger heart wins!

zh-Hans: 好嘞！
en: All right!

zh-Hans: 要拿下了！
en: I'll finish it!

zh-Hans: 好，能行！
en: Yes, I can do it!

zh-Hans: 拿下了！
en: Got you!

zh-Hans: 跑得倒还不错，但要比街头较量，你这跑法还太单薄！
en: You're doing pretty well, but your driving lacks the toughness for a street battle!

zh-Hans: 赌上本地车手的面子，我不会输！这场肯定是硬仗！
en: I won't lose with my home pride at stake! This is going to be a tough battle!
